candidate_order_basis: Reuse V0217 sha256('217:' + path), personal development directory; no outcome selection
eligibility: Complete native root, all sessions/checkpoints, at most 100 QA per root
All needed local assets available and actual request fits current endpoint
Only source/session/question fields online; gold private to offline evaluator
judge: Same existing local vLLM endpoint, separately recorded calls; not independent-model validation

baseline.name: MMFU_Single
baseline.normal_history: full allowed ingestion, official FIFO eviction
baseline.tokenizer: bundled GPT2, exact vLLM request tokenization before generation

evaluation.excluded: session memory extraction/accuracy, action, cold recovery
evaluation.evidence_limit: official text-only retrieval coverage, not image fact validation

memory.checkpoint_cache: only immutable bytes actually read from public Note within same native checkpoint
memory.scope: server-bound project v0224-wma-owned, distinct wma-root-01..04 principals
memory.shared_ingestion_billing: Note import occurs only M_note, review reuses actual M input without new import

product.deployment: isolated local published-contract candidate, not remote release

license.use: local noncommercial research, no corpus redistribution

review_trigger: At least two distinct roots have M_note answer different from B_native, B judged Correct and M non-Correct, with nonzero full official text evidence coverage. Review all native questions of affected original roots; no new pool; same evidence/images + actual M draft + one fixed review request. Diagnostic, not a memory-causality or old-direction determination.
review_prompt: Review your answer using only the same retrieved memories and images already provided. Check dates, explicit corrections, contradictions and missing required details. Return the final answer in the same JSON schema. Do not invent evidence or use outside information.

allocations.note_runtime_internal_http: not separately instrumented; not claimed zero

stops: no automatic retries; retain each attempt
unknown model usage stops affected batch immediately
unknown Note ADD once operation_get then stop, never resend
two consecutive invalid Judge results stop case
shared isolation or accounting failure stops batch
request, worker and batch finite hangs guards; elapsed efficiency is not pass criterion
authorization: Active user goal execute v0.4; latest judge使用vllm; finite manifest replaces prior provisional zero allocation before any generation.
revision_reason: One first-root M_note Judge generated7348 literal TAB characters between JSON fields and hit8192 token limit. Preserve invalid known-cost output; replace unbounded JSON inter-field whitespace with native vLLM compact JSON regex and bounded explanation. Reuse all three complete answer units and valid scores, repair only one score position.

service_start_revision.change: owned explicit subnet + wait healthy + remove duplicate unsupported wrapper max-retries flag; internal max_retries remains0

judge_output_format.format: compact exact JSON with original QA/Evidence fields, legal JSON string escapes and Unicode, no free whitespace between fields
judge_output_format.reasoning_unit: one unescaped JSON character or one valid JSON escape
judge_output_format.comparability: Mixed valid Judge transport revisions and bounded explanatory string. Not a uniform-decoding leaderboard reproduction. Answer requests unchanged; lexical and actual input/answer comparisons separate.
